description: This file provides functions for parsing, formatting, and manipulating date and time data, including timezone conversions, RFC-2822 date parsing, and ISO-8601 formatting.

methods.name: timezoneOffset
methods.description: Converts a timezone string like '+0200' to offset in seconds from UTC.

methods.name: localTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the local browser timezone offset from UTC in seconds.

methods.name: localTimezoneInfo
methods.description: Returns the local timezone as a string in '+/-ZZZZ' format.

methods.name: parseRFC2822Date
methods.description: Parses an RFC-2822 formatted date string into a Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch).

methods.name: formatTimezoneInfo
methods.description: Formats hours and minutes into a timezone string in '+/-HHMM' or '+/-HH:MM' format.

methods.name: normalizeTimezoneInfo
methods.description: Converts 'utc' or 'local' strings into numeric timezone strings.

methods.name: formatDateISOLocal
methods.description: Formats a Unix epoch into a local ISO-8601-like date string with timezone.

methods.name: formatDateRFC2882
methods.description: Formats a Unix epoch into an RFC-2822 date string with timezone.
